offering_description.value: Provides managed care and cost containment services for workers' compensation and group health claims, sold to employers, insurers and third-party administrators. Delivers them through nurse case management, medical bill review, provider networks and pharmacy benefit management, supported by its own claims software.

primary_services.value: workers' compensation case management; medical bill review; provider network management; pharmacy benefit management; group health cost containment

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, self-insured health plans

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for managed care and claims management services per case or claim; transaction or usage fees: per-bill review and per-prescription fees charged to clients
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: manages claims and provider networks for payers and employers, sold to insurers and self-insured plans; software / platform: proprietary claims and bill review software used in delivering services to clients

geography_served.value: US national: Services provided across the United States through a nationwide network of offices

specialization.value: related lines: workers' compensation and group health managed care services sharing claims and provider network technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts sold directly to employers, insurers and third-party administrators; own locations: regional offices serving clients across the United States

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state workers' compensation fee and licensing rules, and HIPAA health data privacy rules
